# Arizona Spurs

> Arizona Spurs is the officially recognized Tottenham Hotspur supporters club for the Phoenix metro area, founded in 2014. Members watch every match together at Fibber Magee's Pub in Chandler, Arizona.

Membership is free. The club is a 501(c)(7) social club, so donations to it are not tax deductible.

Reach the board at board@arizonaspurs.com.

## Club

- [Events](https://www.arizonaspurs.com/events): Watch party schedule at Fibber Magee's Pub
- [Join the Club](https://www.arizonaspurs.com/join): Free membership sign-up
- [About](https://www.arizonaspurs.com/about): Club history and what the club does
- [FAQ](https://www.arizonaspurs.com/faq): Watch parties, membership, match tickets, and more
- [Newsletter](https://www.arizonaspurs.com/newsletter): Match previews, watch party announcements, club news, and past issues
- [Partners](https://www.arizonaspurs.com/partners): The official watch party venue and parent club
